intent_record.intent_summary: Add bounds validation guards to prevent out-of-bounds array access on data[length - 1] in e1000_tbi_should_accept().
intent_record.what: Replaced direct array access `*(data + length - 1)` with guarded bounds checking. Added two validation checks: one for zero length and one for length exceeding adapter->rx_buffer_len, returning false if either condition is true before accessing the array.
intent_record.how: This change prevents out-of-bounds memory access by validating the length parameter before dereferencing the data pointer. If length is 0, the subtraction would cause underflow; if length exceeds rx_buffer_len, it indicates invalid input. Both cases now return early with false instead of proceeding to the unsafe array access.
